active_watches.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Watch issued September 6 at 5:53PM MDT until September 7 at 1:00AM MDT by NWS Great Falls MT
active_watches.description:
THE NATIONAL WEATHER SERVICE HAS ISSUED SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH
662 IN EFFECT UNTIL 1 AM MDT MONDAY FOR THE FOLLOWING AREAS

IN MONTANA THIS WATCH INCLUDES 10 COUNTIES

IN CENTRAL MONTANA

CASCADE               FERGUS                JUDITH BASIN
MEAGHER

IN NORTH CENTRAL MONTANA

BLAINE                CHOUTEAU              HILL
LIBERTY

IN SOUTHWEST MONTANA

BROADWATER

IN WEST CENTRAL MONTANA

LEWIS AND CLARK

THIS INCLUDES THE CITIES OF AUGUSTA, BELT, BIG SANDY, CARTER,
CASCADE, CHESTER, CHINOOK, DEEP CREEK PASS, FLESHER PASS,
FORT BENTON, GRASS RANGE, GREAT FALLS, HARLEM, HAVRE, HAYS,
HELENA, HOBSON, KINGS HILL PASS, LEWISTOWN, LEWISTOWN DIVIDE,
LINCOLN, MACDONALD PASS, MARTINSDALE, RAYNESFORD, ROCKY BOY,
ROGERS PASS, RUDYARD, STANFORD, TOSTON, TOWNSEND,
WHITE SULPHUR SPRINGS, WHITLASH, WINIFRED, AND WINSTON.
